text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... To think that on the day of my 
descent, I would encounter the 
"Enchantress"! Truly, are the chains of 
fate so unbreakable?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
As talkative as ever, I see. —Do you 
really want my congratulations that badly?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, no doubt it would be a bouquet filled 
with blue delphiniums, but— I seek neither 
mercy nor blessings!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, it's the reverse! I am the one 
bestowing blessings! Upon this 
commemorative day in this world, marking 
another celestial cycle since my descent 
from chaos!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And you, Ramonu. Meeting me today makes 
you truly blessed. —I shall fill your cup 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What a grand invitation. Are you going to 
pour me some sweet nectar, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, I have no tedious desire to 
yield you for eternity. Mine is vivid 
enough to scorch the very soul!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let us savor it. Your 
celebratory toast to the world... and its 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's the spirit, my "Fascinating 
Queen"! —Now, take my hand! And let us 
begin! This festival by "Me", for the sake 
of "Myself"!
